experiment_or_item: E2/E3 verdict-shift under untrusted context (C1/C2a/C2b/C3)
result_summary: Context never removes coverage but significantly shifts verdicts: the corruption phenomenon (accuracy shift, not coverage loss).
key_numbers: RR=0.000, UAC~1.0 all conditions; SIUD=0.000 (C2b +0.017 qwen); McNemar y_pred vs C0: qwen C3 p=1.2e-05, llama C3 p=1.94e-04, granite C2a p=7.6e-06, C2b p=6.1e-05; n=60/model
rationale: Backbone of the surviving story (untrusted context corrupts verdicts); pre-registered, 3 models, paired tests; master-verified.

experiment_or_item: E6 P1 semantic isolation reduces IPI-flip (aggregate)
result_summary: P1 cuts injection-driven vulnerable->benign flips 0.742->0.484 with zero usable-answer cost - but aggregate p is driven by the benign stratum (see NEG-07).
rationale: Real, paired, master-verified; must ship with the mandatory decomposition (vul-only p=0.5, benign-keep-bias) per ROUND3_SUMMARY #4.

experiment_or_item: E8 H6 pipeline-level safety + P1 safe-side
result_summary: P2 intent gate blocks all unsafe prompts before any LLM call (safety by construction); P1/P2 do not increase safe-side over-refusal (qwen even reduces it).
key_numbers: P2 gate_blocked 30/30 both models, 0 LLM calls; unsafe 0.000 (by construction); qwen safe refusal B0 0.233->P1 0.000 p=0.0156; llama B0_vs_P2 p=1.0; H6 met both models (recomputed files)
rationale: Recomputed (post-monitor-fix) values only; wording locked to 'pipeline-level, by-construction' - must not read as 'P2 makes the model safer'.

experiment_or_item: B4 CodeBERT baseline (PrimeVul mirror v0.1)
result_summary: Fine-tuned CodeBERT characterizes the transformer channel: weak ranking on paired PrimeVul blocks, usable as fallback baseline.
key_numbers: MCC@0.5 0.2317; AUC 0.8468; VD-S 0.9617; recall@0.5 0.5410; paired rank accuracy 0.223 (n=435); n_test=20,549 (549 vul + 20k benign seed 1234)
rationale: Baseline table with mandatory mirror-v0.1 + benign-subsample disclosure (not official gated release, not full 229k benign).

experiment_or_item: C5 query-relevance + anti-leakage validity
result_summary: The C5 attack is genuinely query-relevant and leak-free, so the R5 null (NEG-02) is not a weak-attack artifact.
key_numbers: Concrete advisory names function's own sinks 100/100; generic zero-API advisory leaks a sink 0/100; legacy C2b carrier named a sink 2/838=0.2%; 0 label/CWE/CVE leaks on 400 renderings; bench sha 2daa249f7543f8e0
rationale: Benchmark-validity evidence that strengthens the headline negative; cheap to keep, pre-empts the 'your attack was generic' reviewer objection.

experiment_or_item: Verdict-bias FP drift (Finding 2 headline)
result_summary: Untrusted risk context biases verdicts toward 'vulnerable': large, significant, strictly one-directional false-positive drift on benign functions.
key_numbers: llama FP 0.817->1.000 (dFP +0.183 [+0.100,+0.283], exact McNemar p=9.8e-04; conditional flips 10/11, 11/11); granite FP 0.000->0.667/0.833 (p=1.9e-06 / 6.0e-08); reverse flips 0 everywhere; PPV 1.000->0.479 at 50/50 prevalence
rationale: Largest practice-risk effect in the project; pre-registered stats settings (bootstrap seed 20260918); the load-bearing quantitative finding of paper 1.

experiment_or_item: VCI direction-symmetry (attack FP-way vs defence FN-way)
result_summary: Same pipeline, two opposite failure modes: untrusted context pushes verdicts toward flagging, the P3 defence toward clearing - quantified by a new index (VCI).
key_numbers: granite attack VCI 0.650/0.750 with FP-direction 0.667/0.833, FN-direction 0.000; llama P3 VCI 0.683/0.700 with FN-direction 0.633/0.667, FP-direction 0.000; granite rec-direction 0.633/0.667 (recall 'gain' = context churn)
rationale: Mechanism-level symmetry claim that unifies Findings 1+2; definitions frozen before computing (§2 of verdict_bias.md).

experiment_or_item: Advisory-echo evidence (did the model read the context?)
result_summary: Granite flip outputs quote the advisory near-verbatim; llama's verdicts move without quoting (confabulated findings); must-be-zero control holds.
key_numbers: granite echo 12/20 (near), 11/25 (far); llama 2/11 both arms; control 0/300 C0 outputs contain advisory vocabulary (asserted)
source_files: outputs/master/round6_bias.json (evidence.*); docs/verdict_bias.md §6 (quotes re-attributed per V1-R6 MINOR-1)
rationale: Discussion-grade mechanism evidence; keep 1 paragraph with the corrected attribution (illustrative quotes are same-arm, not from the benign-flip set).

experiment_or_item: P3 component ablation A0->A5 (Finding 1 mechanism + guidance G1)
result_summary: Pre-registered ladder isolates the culprit: the system task-intent reassertion rung alone collapses llama vulnerable recall; minimal provenance wrapper is harmless.
key_numbers: Ladder recall 1.000/0.983/0.900/0.848/0.898/0.433; A5 rung 28/34 = 82% net flips, exact p=7.45e-09 (chi2-cc 3.35e-07); H-M1/H-M2 SUPPORTED; C5_far replicate recall 0.390, 36/59 flips; qwen 0/60 (inert); guidance G1: keep A1, drop A5
rationale: Turns 'defence is the risk' from observation into mechanism; byte-level rung isolation (A4->A5 differ only by system reassertion); 82% concentration carries the B0-saturated caveat.

experiment_or_item: Verdict-bias extension (power for Finding 2)
result_summary: Fresh-sample extension removes the small-n objection on the FP-bias and shows granite's 'recall gain' is churn (both labels move up together).
key_numbers: llama benign FP 0.820->0.990 combined n=100 (exact p=1.53e-05), vul +8 p=0.0078; granite benign 0.043->0.714, vul 0.057->0.671 combined n=70 (chi2 1.95e-11 / 1.50e-10)
rationale: Per-model source asserts + tests; completes the paired evidence on new samples (no double counting).

experiment_or_item: RQ8 corruption channel generalizes across CWE families
result_summary: Verdict-bias is not a memory-copy-family artifact: granite generalizes to all 4 new CWE families with Bonferroni-surviving pooled effect; llama reported per-family (anti-masking) as pooled-driven.
key_numbers: granite 4/4 families GENERALIZES (verdict.RQ8.granite2b.H_G1 SUPPORTED, family_pass_count 4/4); pooled dFP 0.062->0.700, p=8.88e-16, survives Bonferroni x5; llama H_G1 NOT_SUPPORTED 2/4 (see NEG-15), label GENERALIZES-pooled-driven
rationale: Generalization gate of the paper; per-family rows kept so family failures are not averaged away (charter §13).

experiment_or_item: RQ9 minimal provenance safe at 7B (H_R2)
result_summary: The G1 recommendation transfers: A1 boundary-only wrapper is harmless at 7B, completing 'minimal provenance safe at every measured scale (2B/3B/7B)'.
key_numbers: H_R2 SAFE (A1 recall 0.4576, delta -0.017, p=1.0); prompt identity 120/120 SHA-matched to Round-6; 240 records, RR=0.000
rationale: Small but decision-useful; ship as one sentence beside the RQ9 boundary (NEG-14); family confound caveat mandatory.

experiment_or_item: Refusal pathway of models is functional (instrument validity of RR=0)
result_summary: RR=0.000 everywhere is a model property, not detector blindness: the monitor catches real refusals in calibration/probe sets.
key_numbers: OR-Bench probes 125/225 refused (paper-1 claim); 0.5B smoke 4/5 REFUSAL (smoke_0p5b.json); monitor false-refusal 0.0 (passes <=0.10 floor) both models
rationale: One validity sentence next to every RR=0 claim; full calibration table already in appendix (T9).

experiment_or_item: KB build feasibility at 3B
result_summary: LLM-classified knowledge base is buildable at 3B: 60/60 classified, 0 refusal, 0 retry, 0 UNSURE (vs 8/10 UNSURE at 0.5B).
key_numbers: 60/60 classified by Qwen2.5-Coder-3B; kb_v0001 = 80 entries (20 seed + 60 LLM); fixture KB archived
rationale: Feasibility detail, not a scientific endpoint; KB effect itself is null (NEG-25).

experiment_or_item: TOST equivalence: FedAvg == strong centralized baseline (P0-1/2)
result_summary: Pre-registered equivalence at +/-0.02 F1 margin on the primary leakage-resistant split, 20 seeds, paired - the paper-2 primary detector claim.
key_numbers: group/graph dF1 -0.0065+/-0.0171, 90% CI [-0.0133,+0.0003] PASS; group/hashing -0.0024 [-0.0070,+0.0022] PASS; 360 runs mock=false; AMENDMENT-5 prereg 16:39:29Z < run 16:56:59Z
rationale: Equivalence framing replaces the old descriptive null; central-win on random split must ship beside it (NEG-24) - 'FL is never worse' is explicitly NOT claimed.

experiment_or_item: Graph features beat trivial 5-feature baseline (anti-shortcut, P0-5)
result_summary: Behaviour-graph value is real but bounded: significant margin over a trivial structural baseline that itself reaches F1 .82-.86.
key_numbers: dF1 +0.0227 group / +0.0487 random, exact Wilcoxon p=1.9e-5 / 1.9e-6; subset-500 non-empty still wins p=.0012/1.9e-6; trivial F1 0.8233-0.8555 (artifact-exact .823-.855)
rationale: Rebuttal-ready anti-shortcut check; framing fixed as 'refinement, not replacement'.

experiment_or_item: D1 AST-strip defense neutralizes the advisory channel on granite
result_summary: Byte-provable attack removal: stripping makes granite verdicts identical to baseline on every parseable pair and reverts all attack-induced flips, at zero benign FP.
key_numbers: strip(P2)==strip(original) 38/38 byte-equal; granite P2D1 vs P0: 23/23 verdicts identical, 4/4 flips revert, FP 0/14 (p=1.0); granite .667->.833 under attack -> .652 defended
rationale: Paper-2 defense headline; must ship with the llama cost as first-class outcome (NEG-26) and all-p-descriptive caveat (NEG-27).

experiment_or_item: Graph features vs re-implemented MalGuard/Amalfi-style baseline
result_summary: The 41-feature MalGuard-style reimplementation does not beat the 18-dim graph block (consistent negative direction 8/8); combined only trends positive (n.s.).
key_numbers: graph .8778+/-0.0422 vs malguard .8562+/-0.0421 (group/central); dF1 -0.0216 [-0.0407,-0.0025], raw p=.0441, Holm .3084 (n.s.); combined +0.0150 p=.1054 n.s.; 320 runs bit-exact reproductions; no label leak (V1 permutation check)
rationale: Keep as ablation paragraph with the honest wording (NOT 'worse, significant', NOT 'equivalent'); Holm-non-significance is the load-bearing caveat (NEG-31).

experiment_or_item: GuardDog rule-based baseline (pre-registered)
result_summary: GuardDog is a high-precision triage reference that trails the learned graph model on the primary split - the learned representation claim survives a strong local baseline.
key_numbers: F1 .8627 full / .8662 group / .8571 LCO-t0.30 / .8550 t0.50; precision .9477-.9714, recall .7778-.7958; group split: loses to graph .923-.928; same-origin DataDog bias disclosed (optimistic)
rationale: Comparison-table row with mandatory 'comparable, not superior' wording; LCO 1-seed advantage stays out of main claims (NEG-29).

experiment_or_item: Advisory-in-package shifts verdict sensitivity, family-dependently (corrected reading)
result_summary: Untrusted in-package content causally moves malicious-recall in opposite directions per model - a recall-perturbing channel, unlike paper 1's FP channel.
key_numbers: n=60: granite TP .5333->.8000 (8/0 flips), llama .1333->.0333 (1/4 flips, measured cost); FP on benign 0/180; RR=0/360; n=100 expansion: granite FP 0->2/50, llama 8/8 mal->ben flips
rationale: Standing numbers are the round-9 corrected reading: round-8's 'FP-bias .2->.6, granite 1.0' was a mislabeled TP-rate (see NEG row for the retraction); paper-2 abstract already uses the corrected channel type.
